long_biography.plain_text:
Avesi Partners gave Chris Laitala a platform to apply two decades of middle-market buyout experience to a firm he now leads as managing partner and chief investment officer. Its thematic strategy targets growing, privately held businesses, especially healthcare and business services, with Laitala working alongside founders and executives on expansion and acquisitions.

Before Avesi, he invested at Great Point Partners, H.I.G. Capital and Lindsay Goldberg, developing a focus on growth-oriented healthcare and business-services transactions. He studied at Harvard College, where he played varsity tennis, and later earned an MBA from Harvard Business School. That combination of sector work and transaction experience shaped Avesi's emphasis on specialist operating knowledge and long-term partnerships with management teams.
